name: blueprint/weekly-review
description: The weekly reset (Hermes weekly-review-planning, righthand-native): scan what happened - done and failed tasks, delivered events, receipts - synthesize it with rh_text_summarise, and store the next-week plan as a note. The review is a build, not a memory.
use_cases: what did I actually do this week
keep the review durable across sessions
ingredients: rh_task_list (done + failed carry the week's evidence)
rh_text_summarise for the synthesis + rh_store_put note:review:<week>
recipe: collect: rh_task_list state done + failed -> rh_events_list notified + cancelled -> scan receipt prefixes for the week -> synthesize: rh_text_summarise over the collected facts (what shipped, what stalled and why) -> plan: rh_text_summarise or hand-write the next-week commitments -> store: rh_store_put note:review:<week> { done, failed, delivered, plan, at } -> next review starts by reading the previous one
result_kind: one review note per week, chained to the previous

config_variants.chain: link to the previous review in the note

cost_hint: one or two model calls per review; everything else free
pitfalls: failed tasks are the review's gold - the result field says what was tried and what broke; done tasks alone flatter the week
cancelled events are news too - the record says what was retracted
chain the notes: each review reads the previous one's plan and answers it
the review is only as true as the receipts - if the week's work never wrote them, the review cannot see it
store the plan as a note, not a promise - next week's agent may be a fresh context
local_limits: sees only what rh_* tools recorded - invisible work stays invisible
cloud_limits: same LLM config as the text family
